u.t: Reading, writing and comparing whole numbers beyond 1,000,000

l.t: Introduction on the content of the unit
l.o:
Identify objects with content about the numbers beyond 1,000,000 in real life.
Manila cards flash cards chalkboard illustrations pens pencils. Abacus Different counters
l.c: Sign posts, bank slip, Whole numbers, Millions, Hundred thousand, Less than, Greater than.
l.a: In groups, pupils will identify numbers beyond 1,000,000 and objects where they can find suc numbers. Harmonize their work and arouse their curiosity on the content of this unit.
l.e: Pupils will be able to give oral answers on examples of numbers beyond 1,000,000 and objects or things that contain such numbers.
l.r: MATHEMATIC S PRIMARY 6 PUPIL’S BOOK Version Edited in 2026(page1-2)

l.t: Place Values of whole Numbers up to 7 digits
l.o:
Write the place value of each digit in the given 7- digits’ number.
Manila cards flash cards chalk illustrations pens pencils. Abacus Different counters
l.c: Place value: Ones, Tens, Hundreds, Thousands Hundred thousands, Millions.
l.a: In small groups of discussion, pupils will do the activity Identify place values Harmonize answers Guide the whole class
l.e: Pupils will be given oral and written questions about writing the place value of each digit of a number, matching digits to their place values.
l.r: MATHEMATIC S PRIMARY 6 PUPIL’S BOOK Version Edited in 2026(page2-4)

l.t: Forming numbers beyond 1,000,000 by using number cards or given digits, reading and writing the formed numbers in figures
l.o:
Accurately form, read and write numbers beyond 1,000,000 in figures.
Manila cards flash cards chalk illustrations pens pencils. Abacus Different counters
l.c: Place value Ones Tens Hundreds Thousands Hundred thousands Millions
l.a: Help learners to form groups Pupils will do the activity 1.1 in their books. Monitor learners’ progress
l.e: Pupils should be given written questions about forming biggest and smallest numbers and reading them
l.r: MATHEMATIC S PRIMARY 6 PUPIL’S BOOK Version Edited in 2026(page4-5)
